best_idea: Gate the flinch on the size of the hit, not on every hit: a hit flinches only when its whole-point damage reaches the target's level plus a margin (or the target is on a fixed always-hard list), and a killing blow skips the flinch entirely.
decision_why: Take the gate and the stagger as a state change (the monster stops, plays the got-hit clip, then returns to stand), which fits engage-is-a-state-change. Do not take the donor's client-applied damage path (player.cpp 629-643) or its unlimited re-stagger: they conflict with server-verified kills and MAX_ATTACKERS = 3.
acceptance: In the Pit, a 9-point hit on a level-3 gladiator (threshold 6) moves it into the got-hit state for the clip length and holds its position, while a 4-point hit plays only the hit sound and the gladiator keeps its move; a server test asserts both outcomes on the monster state, and a Frankendom rule (not in donor) caps re-staggers inside a cooldown so three attackers cannot lock one gladiator in the got-hit clip.
